name: coat_front_skirt_panel
where: Front coat skirt lower panels either side of the central opening, hanging to about y0.19-0.21 at the points; left panel x~0.52-0.62, right panel x~0.30-0.42
shape: Long blue cloth panel with a pointed V-shaped lower tip and thick folded-hem thickness.
notes: Lies over trousers and underskirt. Gold trim and orange wear are paint on the sculpt. Probably belongs to a coat region too; listed here for the hem.

name: coat_front_panel_gold_trim
where: Along the inner diagonal edge and the pointed bottom edge of each front panel, y~0.19-0.30
shape: Raised flat gold border strip following the V edge of the panel.
notes: Clay shows a stepped raised rim, so it is geometry, not paint. Sits on top of the cloth panel.

name: coat_side_skirt_panel
where: Coat flank panels seen in left/right views, hem y~0.20-0.33 with sharp tips trailing toward the back (z~0.30 to 0.45 range side view)
shape: Angled blue cloth panel with a long sharp trailing point and a gold-edged front.
notes: Layered behind the front panels.

name: coat_back_skirt_with_hem_teeth
where: Whole back of coat hem, x~0.30-0.62, hem line y~0.22-0.30
shape: Pleated blue back skirt whose bottom edge is cut into a row of downward triangular teeth with a thickened hem rim.
in_reference: differs: reference back has a central vent and long gold-trimmed pointed back panels; sculpt has a toothed hem
notes: The back vent split is partly visible in the clay back view. Hem teeth are about 8 to 10 per full back width, uneven sizes.

name: coat_hem_teeth_rim
where: Edge of the back and side hem y~0.22-0.30
shape: Thick folded rim running along the toothed hem edge.
notes: May be only the cloth thickness rather than a separate hem band.

name: coat_inner_lining_panel
where: Dark inner lining visible inside front opening and side hem, x~0.45-0.52 between the legs, y~0.15-0.30
shape: Dark brown/near-black flat panel hanging between the front panels with a jagged lower edge.
notes: Overlaps with the central underskirt strip below; hard to separate from underskirt.

name: underskirt_centre_strip
where: Centre front between the legs, x~0.44-0.52, y~0.14-0.30
shape: Long brown-black rectangular tapering strip with a ragged pointed lower end.
notes: Sits under the blue front panels, over the trousers.

name: underskirt_tattered_strips
where: Ring of strips around both legs below the coat hem, y~0.12-0.23; densest at back and sides, hanging to about y0.12-0.15
shape: Narrow flat strips with pointed or notched lower ends in brown-black, of varying lengths, overlapping in several layers.
seen_in: out/survey_hem_tex.png back, bl, br, left, right
notes: Count is a rough estimate (about 25 to 35). Two or three layers: a shorter outer layer, a longer inner layer. Side views show some strips as thin vertical sticks (see underskirt_side_sticks).

name: underskirt_side_sticks
where: Thin long detached slabs at the outer side/back of each leg, left view z~0.28-0.45 and right view mirrored, y~0.12-0.30
shape: Very thin vertical plank-like strips hanging straight down, almost edge-on, dark with square-cut or pointed ends.
in_reference: differs: reference shows jagged shredded edge but not distinct sticks
notes: Several parallel slabs per side, possibly the outer tatter layer seen edge-on. May be the same objects as the tattered strips.

name: underskirt_front_flap
where: Under each front panel, in front of each thigh/knee, x~0.32-0.42 and x~0.52-0.60, y~0.15-0.28
shape: Brown-black angled flap with pointed lower tip following the front coat panel shape.
notes: Directly under the gold-trimmed blue panels; partly lies on trousers.

name: trouser_leg
where: Left leg x~0.50-0.60, right leg x~0.34-0.42, y~0.12-0.30 visible
shape: Baggy dark trouser leg with vertical creases, gathered in at the cuff above the boot.
notes: Pulled over the boot top. Mostly hidden by the coat and strips from the back.

name: trouser_cuff
where: Just above boot top, y~0.12-0.16 (left leg x~0.50-0.60, right leg x~0.33-0.45)
shape: Gathered rolled band where the trouser leg ends, overhanging the boot top.
notes: Sits over the boot shaft; the boot shaft emerges beneath it.

name: boot_shaft
shape: Tall near-cylindrical leather shaft with soft vertical wrinkles and a seam down the front.
notes: Faint front seam visible on both. Both shafts end under the trouser cuff.

name: boot_vamp_upper
where: Left boot z~0.12-0.22, y~0.02-0.07 over the instep; same on right boot
shape: Wrinkled leather piece over the foot and ankle joining the shaft to the toe.
notes: Has soft folds across the instep; transitions into toe cap and heel counter.

name: boot_toe_cap
where: Front of the foot, y~0.00-0.04, left boot z~0.17-0.22+; right boot likewise
shape: Rounded cap covering the toe, with a raised seam line behind it.
notes: Separated from the vamp by a raised band/stitched ridge.

name: boot_instep_band
where: Across the foot at the instep, y~0.03-0.05, orange-edged in paint
shape: Raised curved band wrapping over the foot behind the toe cap, with orange wear along its edge.
in_reference: differs: reference shows two buckled straps rather than a plain band
notes: Could be interpreted as the toe cap seam rather than a separate strap.

name: boot_heel_counter
where: Back of the boot, y~0.00-0.05, left boot z~0.06-0.12
shape: Rounded half-disc cup panel around the heel, outlined by a raised seam edge.
notes: The semicircular outline is clear in the side clay views.

name: boot_sole
where: Bottom of each boot, y~0.00-0.012; left boot x~0.49-0.62, right boot x~0.31-0.46
shape: Thin flat welt-edged sole plate protruding slightly around the boot outline, with a ridged tread section under the arch.
notes: Orange painted edge line is wear. Bottom view shows tread grooves in the arch area.

name: boot_heel_block
where: Under the heel, y~0.00-0.015, left boot z~0.06-0.11
shape: Short stacked heel block slightly separated from the sole forefoot by an arch gap.
notes: A visible gap under the arch separates the heel from the forefoot sole.

name: boot_ankle_strap
where: Around the ankle at y~0.055-0.075, outer side of the boot (left boot outer side toward +x, right boot toward -x)
shape: Horizontal strap wrapping the ankle, whose end tab/keeper is visible as a rounded rectangle on the outer side.
notes: Wraps the whole ankle. From the front it forms a ring bulge. Buckle is not modelled in detail.

name: boot_ankle_strap_tab
where: Outer side of ankle, y~0.06-0.075, left boot z~0.10-0.13
shape: Rounded rectangular tab lying on the strap, where the strap end passes through.
notes: Where a buckle sits in the reference; the sculpt has only a flat tab and no buckle frame.

name: boot_ankle_strap_rear_roll
where: Back of ankle, y~0.06-0.08
shape: Thick rolled ridge that wraps the ankle at the back and bulges at the sides.
notes: Same strap as above, just its back portion.

name: boot_instep_strap_stud
where: Outer side of the foot, y~0.04-0.05, left boot z~0.13-0.15
shape: Small raised teardrop/button lump at the end of the lower strap.
in_reference: differs: reference has gold buckles here
notes: Left and right are the same; the sculpt button is a bump, no buckle ring.

name: boot_inner_ankle_bulge
where: Inner side of ankle, y~0.05-0.07
shape: Round padded bulge on the inner ankle seen from the front.
notes: Possibly the strap loop wrapping around rather than an object.

name: boot_buckles
where: Ankle strap and instep strap on each boot, outer side
shape: Gold rectangular buckles per the reference, one on the ankle strap and one on the instep strap per boot.
notes: Missing in the sculpt: only plain tabs and a button. Orange paint along band edges hints at trim but is not geometry. Left and right boots are near mirror images, with no significant differences found.
